scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional dark theme with a controlled CSS-variable palette and clear typographic hierarchy (uppercase panel labels, muted axis text) lifts this above generic, but the D3 API co-occurrence network is an unreadable dense hairball at rendered size, and the thumbnail gallery is cramped enough that individual blocks can't be distinguished.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline and scaleSqrt area encoding are correct throughout, but the network panel recalculates node-size domains on every filter change, violating the subset invariant (remaining nodes visually rescale instead of staying fixed).
scores.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag correctly batches all DOM renders, but unthrottled O(n) bitmask recomputation on each brush event will cause CPU jank on large datasets; no mid-flight snap, loop, or touch-fight issues found.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The force-layout network (60 nodes, links at median co-occurrence threshold) reads as a dense hairball with limited visible cluster separation, and the simultaneous thumbnail grid (~30+ visible cells) compounds working memory load, though the logically grouped panels, dark-theme restraint, and pre-rendered static simulation prevent it from collapsing entirely.
flags: Update Storm: O(n) bitFilter.set()+filtered() runs synchronously on every brush mousemove — only rendering is RAF-coalesced, not the computation
Stale Closure: x/y scales captured in brush closures at creation time with no resize handler — scales silently stale after window resize

proposer: Deduplicated the search/filter logic from `renderList` and `updateThumbWall` into a shared `getFiltered` helper. Net savings: ~5 lines (removed 12 duplicate lines, added 7 for the shared function).
